title: sieni's Adachi Rei music discs
description: Replaces the records of music discs with Adachi Rei songs :3
body:
# sieni's Adachi Rei music discs

This resource pack modifies all music discs in the game to play Adachi Rei songs!

**NOTE!** Due to the way music discs work internally in Minecraft, the songs will abruptly cut where the original record would stop. You'll need to install [this mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/jukebox-custom-disc-fix) alongside the pack to fix it.

## Songs included

... and which do they replace:

* 13 — A Moment of Blue and Flowers / 瞬間の青と花 (by Singh)
* cat — To Feel Alive (by Phantoskii)
* blocks — The Seventh Dam / 第7ダム (by num335)
* chirp — The Mechanical Girl and the 30-Something Office Lady / 機械少女と三十路OL (by Ro2noki)
* far — Daibousou! / 大暴走! (by HAYAPAN)
* mall —  You've Got Mail! (by Phantoskii)
* mellohi — Electric Lamb (by yumigurumi)
* stal — I wanna shower (by thomascoolkid)
* strad — There's Nobody / 相反するネガイ (by 阿修)
* ward — Become Your Heart (by Du Du Danyon)
* 11 — My Bread was Burnt to a Crisp / パンこげこげになっちゃった (by picdo)
* wait — Net Empath / ネットエンパス (by takeisu)
* Pigstep — Heat Abnormal / 熱異常 (by iyowa)
* otherside — the Hole / 足立レイ (by r-906)
* 5 — Super Complex / すーぱーこんぷれっくす (by ¿?)
* Relic — Let's Head to Paradise / 桃源郷へ行こう (by picdo)
* Creator — Queen of Venus (by FLAVOR FOLEY)
* Creator (Music Box) — utau bot (by 原口沙輔)
* Precipice — Dance Delightful (by Jaime Paige)
* Tears — GIMMICK GIRL (by MonochroMenace)
* Lava Chicken — milk (by stickii)
* Bounce — Adachi Rei / アダチ・レイ (by 佐藤ちなみに)

## Acknowledgements

All songs included belong to their respective creators.

All textures are modifications of art belonging to Mojang Studios.

Thumbnail art is from _My Bread was Burnt to a Crisp_ by picdo.

Inspired by [Starry's Teto Music Discs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/starrys-teto-music-discs)!
